title: Northgate Branch to open on Sundays from April
body: Northgate Branch will open on Sundays from 6 April, 11:00 to 16:00, and will close at 17:00 on Saturdays instead of 13:00. The district board approved the extended hours as a twelve-month trial.

title: Northgate weekend visits up since Sunday opening
body: Northgate Branch counted 1,880 weekend visits in June, against 1,410 in June last year, according to the branch's door counter. The branch manager said Sunday afternoons were the busiest of the new hours. The figures cover one month only.

title: Millbrook Branch extends Saturday hours
body: From 31 May, Millbrook Branch will stay open until 18:00 on Saturdays, up from 13:00. Its Sunday hours are unchanged: the branch remains closed on Sundays.

title: Millbrook's later Saturdays draw few visitors
body: Three months into longer Saturday hours, Millbrook Branch reports about 960 weekend visits a month, close to the 940 a month it recorded over the same months last year. Staff said the extra evening hours were mostly quiet. The district has not decided whether to keep the later closing time.

title: Stonecross book sale raises funds for the children's room
body: The Friends of Stonecross Branch held their summer book sale on Saturday, raising money toward new seating for the children's room. Volunteers said the sale drew a steady crowd all day.

title: Board discusses a weekend hours trial
body: At its November meeting the district board discussed trialling extended weekend hours at some branches next year. No branches were chosen and no dates were set.

title: Linden Street weekend visits steady
body: Linden Street Branch, whose weekend hours did not change this year, recorded 1,020 weekend visits in September against 1,000 in September last year.

title: District reports a rise in weekend visits
body: The district's annual report says weekend visits across all branches rose this year. The report gives no figures for weekend visits and does not break them down by branch.

title: Stonecross car park to close for resurfacing
body: The Stonecross Branch car park will close for two weeks from 28 April while it is resurfaced. The branch stays open, and visitors are asked to use street parking on Mill Lane.

title: Sunday opening lifts Northgate visits
body: Weekend visits at Northgate Branch rose to 1,880 in June from 1,410 a year earlier, the branch's door counter shows. Sunday afternoons were the busiest of the new hours, the branch manager said.
